name: Mam cong Can Giuoc
summary: Mắm còng, a crab paste from Cần Giuộc in the old Long An half, named among the area’s specialties.
origin: The old Long An half of Tây Ninh, joined to the province by Resolution 202/2025/QH15.
howToEat: Look for it with the other old Long An specialties.
seoDescription: Mắm còng, the crab paste of Cần Giuộc in the old Long An half.
